query:
UPDATE labels l SET position = n.position
         FROM (
             SELECT k.id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.at, k.position, k.id) AS position
             FROM labels k
             LEFT JOIN unnest($2::int4[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(id, at) ON t.id = k.id
             WHERE k.account_id = $1
         ) n
         WHERE l.id = n.id
